title: Pingu's Hats
description: This Project simply changes all of the helmets to hats, its really fun for bedwars and other games. I personally like it because of the fact that you can still see your minecraft skin while playing.
body:
This Project simply changes all of the helmets to hats, its really fun for bedwars and other games. I personally like it because of the fact that you can still see your minecraft skin while playing. 

Leather -> Top hat
![Leather Hats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc2de1a0c3760d8af91bed8b23afb2babf072c16.png)

Gold -> Crown
![Golden Crown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/900f0b9a22c05b8762ab5dafa521dead491ae8e2.png)

Copper -> mining helmet
![Mining Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a3adb713d56e744a79e7898677ed265bed3e3cf.png)

Iron -> Winged Greek Petasos
![Winged Greek Petasos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/319040a524a024cd2f6c848dd7bdeaf49867a317.png)

Diamond -> conductor's hat
![conductor's hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9bdf8d596ab959f137d39b7eb2712e48567fa83.png)

Netherite -> Lava Mask
![Netherite Mask](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a466e8300cbd0b7a9f77a7eb052aea38ff5202a1.png)

Chainmail -> Magic Hat
![Magic Hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcb449f96d3be38be1b7dc16763ac539b29916d3.png)

Turtle shell -> Turtle Hat
![Turtle Hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e06fdbb228f312bbec08c65e4af06164ef5399b8.png)

This pack is in good working order but can look weird with trims.
